lede: Atlanta Falcons carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#20 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Pittsburgh Steelers -0.8 with a fair total of 43.7 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Pittsburgh Steelers pass offence vs Atlanta Falcons pass defence, which sits −0.053 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
